7628f6e877da63dfb48dcb45e140f205eb83c40e.summary: IBM Trusteer researchers describe ZeuS.Maple, a heavily modified ZeuS 2.0.8.9 variant seen since January 2014 that mainly targets Canadian banks. It uses browser re-patching, an encrypted registry-stored configuration, disguised executable names, anti-debugging and anti-VM checks, and nginx-based command and control. Its configuration lists 14 leading Canadian financial institutions plus generic e-commerce URL patterns. The report was published on 2014-06-09.

764d71dadafd4fce8eaa4ce62e9a901b33bbcef8.summary: Recorded Future's Insikt Group reports on GrayAlpha, a threat actor cluster overlapping with the financially motivated group FIN7. Three infection vectors are described: fake browser update pages, fake 7-Zip download pages, and the TAG-124 traffic distribution system. Custom PowerShell loaders PowerNet and MaskBat deliver NetSupport RAT. At the time of writing only the fake 7-Zip pages were still active. Most infrastructure sits with bulletproof hosting providers. The report says the relationship between GrayAlpha and TAG-124 is unknown.

766f3167d1b570fc5b0005e9268412836c330c51.summary: DOJ press release (published 2025-12-30): a federal court in the Southern District of Florida accepted guilty pleas from Ryan Goldberg and Kevin Martin over extortion using ALPHV BlackCat ransomware attacks in 2023. Per court documents, the group hit more than 1,000 victims via a ransomware-as-a-service model. The men took a 20% affiliate share, extorted about $1.2 million in Bitcoin and laundered the proceeds. A December 2023 FBI disruption gave victims a decryption tool, saving about $99 million. Sentencing is set for March 12, 2026.
